preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 5000.
The length of the string s must be between 1 and 5000.

preconditions.expression: len(s) == n and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s must have length n and consist only of lowercase latin letters.

postconditions.description: The output must consist of the lexicographically smallest string s' followed by the chosen value of k.

postconditions.expression: all(s_prime[i] <= s_prime[i+1] for i in range(len(s_prime)-1))
postconditions.description: The string s' must be lexicographically smallest among all possible modifications.
The chosen value of k must be between 1 and n.
